---
name: Bug report
about: something broke, or lied to you about working
title: ''
labels: bug, needs-triage
assignees: ''
---

describe what happened in your own words; a short report is fine. **report a bug** on neuron's SYSTEM page fills most of this in for you. a device that isn't picked up, stays dark or ignores a setting? press **check** on its row on the DEVICE page, then **report**: that opens the device report instead.

**device + connection** (if relevant)
model, and whether it's wired, dongle or Bluetooth.

**OS version**
Windows build (`winver`), or your Linux distro if you built from source.

**neuron version**

**what happened**


**what you expected instead**


**how to reproduce it**
the shortest path you know of.

**diagnostics** (optional)
the zip **report a bug** makes, or what SYSTEM's read-only diagnostics bench says. no need to attach your whole setup.

**anything else**
crash log (`neuron-crash.log`), relevant config snippets or a screenshot. please leave out serial numbers, paths and private data.
